body:
## Problem

PR #7666 delivered slice 1 of the serve-proxy implementation: the typed frame codec and local credit primitive. PR #13859 later added mux-level credit accounting. The original issue #7569 is closed, but its acceptance still includes leg establishment, full mux routing/scheduling, keepalive/dead-leg handling, resumption, and the E2E ciphertext-forwarding test; #7666's own body lists these as remaining, and #13859 states it does not wire a live leg.

The #5792 decision record already settles the protocol. This issue tracks the remaining implementation slices without changing its trust, fallback, or E2E decisions. #5798's fleet-surface design is separate.

## Remaining acceptance

- Establish TLS 1.3/TCP legs over HTTP CONNECT where required and the optional WebSocket binary-message adapter where CONNECT is denied; both carry the same typed frames.
- Map per-leg stream IDs and schedule control, interactive, and bulk streams across the two connection classes without control frames queuing behind DATA.
- Implement fake-clock keepalive/dead-leg behavior: PING after 25 seconds with ±20% jitter, dead after three unanswered PINGs, and close silent legs into the resume window after 120 seconds.
- Implement broker-issued identity-bound resume tokens and signed RESUME, per-stream sequence/delivered-up-to vectors, exact replay of the unacknowledged tail, and the five-minute in-memory resume window.
- Add the E2E test: forward ciphertext between a UDP-denied client leg and server rendezvous leg while proving the broker cannot read plaintext.
- Preserve the #5792 invariants: no content keys, no payload logging, no disk persistence in v1, no credit overrun, and no duplicate or reordered per-stream delivery.

## First slice

Start with leg establishment (TLS/CONNECT and the WebSocket adapter) and a transport-level test that round-trips typed frames through each supported leg. Keep later mux scheduling, keepalive, resumption, and E2E forwarding as separate reviewable slices.

## Evidence

- PR #7666 merged the codec slice only and enumerated the remaining acceptance above.
- PR #13859 merged mux credit accounting but states no live leg is wired yet.
- Issue #7569 closed at PR #7666 despite the incomplete acceptance; a closure-review pointer is on audit umbrella #13871.
